title: Return an empty successful reply
summary: Ruby on Rails: Return an empty successful reply. Inspect the response with an HTTP client.
introduction: head sends a status and no body. DELETE /books/1 returns 204 in this practice-only action.
learningObjectives: Return an empty successful reply with Ruby on Rails
Inspect the response with an HTTP client

blocks.text: Create a practice project with rails new school --api --skip-active-record. Enter it. Put each labelled section into its named file, then run bin/rails server -b 127.0.0.1 -p 8000. No database is needed.

blocks.title: Return an empty successful reply
blocks.code:
# config/routes.rb
Rails.application.routes.draw do
delete "/books/:id", to: "lesson#destroy"
end

# app/controllers/lesson_controller.rb
class LessonController < ActionController::API
def destroy
 head :no_content
end
end

blocks.text: head :no_content selects status 204 and has no JSON or text body.
Inspect the response with an HTTP client.

blocks.text: This sample has no stored records; it demonstrates the response shape only.
